cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for admitting you broke the vase. I pointed at the dog just as firmly as you did.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was pointing him away from the glass, not saying he broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, keeping him clear. Now apologize for letting me spend three days calling him destructive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. I'll take him for a long walk to make it up to him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me you should have corrected me before you take him. He gets the walk; I need that sentence.

reason: Replace the generic confidence prefaces with a specific misunderstood copied action whose correction shapes the Drive, keeping each alternative a different negotiation with B.
